name: Pasatiempo Golf Club
location: Santa Cruz, Santa Cruz County, California
architects: Alister MacKenzie (opened 1929, for Marion Hollins; bunkers shaped by Robert Hunter and Paddy Cole); restored by Tom Doak and Jim Urbina (1996-2007); every green and bunker rebuilt by Jim Urbina (2023-24)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project CA_SantaCruzCounty_2020_A20 (tile USGS_1M_10_x58y410, published 2021-06-10), NAD83 / UTM 10N, NAVD88 metres; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31 and clipped to the world + 100 m by intake.py raster

world.note: OSM course boundary (relation 13921737, 1,051 x 2,056 m in EPSG:32610) + 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred. 2,304 m north-south is over the 2,048 m guideline (COURSE_BUILD.md 6.1): the boundary alone is 2,056 m tall. Same height as ogc and tpc_boston (strawberry_farms is 2,816), which load and play; developer's call pending (validation_report open items).

scorecard_source: The club's printed Gentlemen's Card (Golf ScoreCards Inc., printed 4/2026; images scorecard_1/4__large.jpg from pasatiempo.com, fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-10-31, release data-pasatiempo): Gold, Gold/White, White, White/Green and Green rows, men's par and handicap, ratings Gold 72.7/143, Gold/White 71.5/139, White 70.7/138, White/Green 69.5/135, Green 68.5/133; every row adds up to its printed totals. Team Match, Green/Hollins and Hollins (not on the gentlemen's card) are Stymie's rows (unverified, not built). The card's handicaps differ from Stymie/GolfPass on holes 6/7 and 12/13 (swapped), and its White/Green row on 1, 9 and 16: the card is used. Par 70 (35-35).
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (CA Santa Cruz County 2020 lidar)
Imagery: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP)
notes: Overnight build 2026-10-30/31 (developer asleep; calls logged in validation_report.md and docs/courses/pasatiempo.md). Tee sets: the back set (Gold) and the set just forward of it (White; the card has no Blue and Gold/White is a combo of the two); default White. Wind 2-10 mph: inland coastal hills ~4 km from Monterey Bay, as at Stanford.
